source.title: pyca/cryptography Documentation
source.applicability: Cryptographic recipe and primitive implementations for Python applications, covering symmetric encryption, key derivation, X.509 certificates, and hazardous materials layer operations

passages.text: cryptography includes both high level recipes and low level interfaces to common cryptographic algorithms such as symmetric ciphers, message digests, and key derivation functions.
